title: American National vs. U.S. Citizen: What's the Difference?
summary: Short explainer promoting a switch from US citizen to American national status, claiming nationals need not pay income tax or serve on juries.

assertions.quote: American nationals are not required to report income and pay taxes on money earned.

verdicts.note: Claims to be solely a citizen of a sovereign state and not subject to federal tax are uniformly rejected (14th Amendment gives simultaneous state and federal citizenship); the document does not address formal expatriation, so this judges the state-national prong.

assertions.quote: For some, it's the lessened burden of certain federal obligations, such as not being required to serve on a jury.
Now, how does one go about changing their status? It involves a detailed process, including paperwork
